audit_scope: Worker-4 source-reviewed DBAASP linked assay/experiment/literature rows against primary XML/PDF/OA package, Table 1, MG-63 and biofilm results text/figures, and merged sequence/literature database rows; unsupported database endpoint/target labels remain source_conflict cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary paper labels the streptococcal target as S. sanguis 10556/ATCC10556, while linked DBAASP rows use Streptococcus sanguinis ATCC 10566; endpoint/value support is not normalized into a clean target match.
Primary results support Pac-525 biofilm activity at 0.5 mg/mL but do not state an MBEC50 endpoint; DBAASP MBEC50 label remains source_conflict.
Primary sequences include Ac-/NH2 terminal annotations; database core sequence rows omit terminal annotations, so final review records modifications explicitly instead of silently normalizing them.
